Tribunal size: Under CPWD GCC 2020 Clause 25, a sole arbitrator is used where the claimed amount is Rs. 20 Crore or less, and a three-member tribunal is used only where the claim is more than Rs. 20 Crore [S1]. Appendix XVII includes a certification that the applicant has exhausted the DRC provisions under Clause 25 [S6]. The notice must also be accompanied by a list of disputes with the amounts claimed [S2].

gold_answer: Only if your permanent registration (स्थायी पंजीयन) has completed two years.
